name: What are the best storage solutions for a guest bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the best storage solutions for a guest bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective storage in a guest bath balances hidden space for backup supplies with easily accessible areas for visitor essentials. A vanity equipped with deep pull-out drawers makes better use of vertical space than an open cabinet with plumbing obstructions. Installing a recessed medicine cabinet gives guests dedicated space for toiletries without taking up counter space. Built-in shower niches keep shampoo and soap off the floor or ledge, while decorative open shelving or a small linen tower provides an obvious spot for clean towels and toilet paper.
acceptedAnswer.description: Vanities with pull-out drawers, recessed medicine cabinets, built-in shower niches, and open wall shelves provide practical storage without cluttering counters.
